meta.question_2: when did each region's load go flat?
meta.region_rule: BA or BA/ZONE demand from EIA-930 via PUDL; >= 500 MW mean demand and >= 90% of hours reported in both 2019 and 2025 -- identical to the shipped detector, recomputed here from parquet, not read from it

method.input: normalized 24-hour local-time mean demand profile per region-year
method.normalization: each profile divided by its own mean (averages to 1.0)

primary.spec: pooled region-years 2019-2025, annual mean profile, mean-normalized

method.series: monthly mean overnight (00-05 local) demand / monthly mean demand
method.seasonal_adjustment: calendar-month climatology removed; level and trend kept
method.penalty: 2.0 * sigma_hat^2 * log(n), sigma_hat from MAD of first differences
